content_sections.heading: IIM Lucknow Research Associate Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate position under Prof. Vishakha Chauhan in the Marketing Management Area.

content_sections.heading: IIM Lucknow Research Associate Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Preference shall be given to candidates who have demonstrated research experience in publishing high-quality research papers in the domain of marketing. Proficiency in conducting qualitative research and experiments. Ability to use SPSS, MAXQDA, SmartPLS, Qualtrics, and Prolific for data collection and analysis.

rows.qualification_required: Ph.D. in Marketing, demonstrating strong research competence and subject expertise, with an excellent academic record and First Class performance throughout from a reputed institute or university completed in regular mode. Must have at least one research publication in a peer-reviewed journal (national or international).

content_sections.heading: IIM Lucknow Research Associate Salary
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly fellowship ranging from Rs. 60,000/- plus HRA as per applicable norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Lucknow Research Associate
content_sections.text: Visit the online application link provided in the important links section. Fill out the application form with all required details. Upload a detailed CV. Submit the application before the deadline of 25 October 2026. Note that no other mode of application will be accepted.

content_sections.text: The position is purely contractual in nature for an initial period of one year, extendable based on performance and institute requirements. Incomplete or ineligible applications will be deemed invalid and rejected without intimation. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted via email for an online interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview if called. Canvassing through any means will lead to immediate rejection. This is an offline position, and the selected candidate must move to Lucknow for the duration of the contract. Applications received after the last date and incomplete applications shall be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the IIM Lucknow Research Associate recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by IIM Lucknow to hire one Research Associate in the Marketing Management Area under Prof. Vishakha Chauhan.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIM Lucknow Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Associate post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIM Lucknow Research Associate?
faq.answer: The last date to receive applications is 25 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for IIM Lucknow Research Associate?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Marketing with a First Class academic record throughout from a reputed regular institute or university, and at least one research publication in a peer-reviewed journal.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for IIM Lucknow Research Associate?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly fellowship ranging from Rs. 60,000/- plus HRA as per applicable norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for IIM Lucknow Research Associate?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for IIM Lucknow Research Associate?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online and upload their detailed CV through the official link provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IIM Lucknow Research Associate?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinized, and only shortlisted candidates are contacted via email for an online interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely contractual for an initial period of one year, which may be extended based on performance and institute requirements.
